texts.preamble: Manoj Kumar Patro vs State Of Odisha & Others .... Opp . ... on 3 February, 2025 Author: K.R. Mohapatra Bench: K.R. Mohapatra In The High Court Of Orissa At Cuttack W.P.(C). No.7896 Of 2024 Manoj Kumar Patro .... Petitioner Mr. Debidutta Mohapatra, Advocate -versus- State of Odisha & others .... Opp. Parties Mr. S. K. Parhi, Asc (For O.P. No.1) Ms. Prajna Priyambada, Advocate (For Opp. Party Nos.2 & 3) Mr. S. Sanjib Swain, Advocate (For O.P. No.4) Coram: Justice K.R. Mohapatra Justice Sanjay Kumar Mishra Order Order No. 03.02.2025 02. 1.
texts.facts: 2. The Petitioner apprehending eviction of his Tiffin Stall has filed this writ petition seeking for a direction to allow him to continue his business in the place, where his Tiffin Stall is operating. The case of the Petitioner was recommended by the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs, Government of India to avail the benefit under PMSVA Nidhi Scheme. The Petitioner made an application on 21st March, 2024 in the prescribed format to issue street vending license in his favour, which is yet to be considered. Hence, this writ petition has been filed for the aforesaid relief. Copy of the said application annexed to the writ petition as Annexure-2 does not bear any signature in token of receipt of such application. Although the application is stated to have been filed on 21st March, 2024, immediately thereafter the writ petition has been filed on 23rd March, 2024. The Petitioner has no locus standi to be issued with a street vending license.
texts.arguments: 3. Mr. Mohapatra, learned counsel submits that the Petitioner was issued with a Food Safety & Standards Authority of India Certificate by the Health & Family Welfare Department, Government of Odisha on 16th January, 2021 (Annexure-1), which was valid till 15th January, 2022. The Petitioner is running such Tiffin Stall at Railway Station Square, Unit-III, Kharavela Nagar, Bhubaneswar. Ms. Prajna Priyambada, learned counsel for Bhubaneswar Municipal Corporation submits that no such application has yet been received by the Town Vending Committee of Bhubaneswar Municipal Corporation (BMC). 5. Considering the submissions made by learned counsel for the parties, this Court feels that if the Petitioner intends to get vending certificate under the provisions of the Street Vendors (Protection of Livelihood and Regulation of Street Vending) Act, 2014 and the Rules framed thereunder, he should make a fresh application in that regard enclosing relevant documents and information.
texts.petitioner_arguments: 3. Mr. Mohapatra, learned counsel submits that the Petitioner was issued with a Food Safety & Standards Authority of India Certificate by the Health & Family Welfare Department, Government of Odisha on 16th January, 2021 (Annexure-1), which was valid till 15th January, 2022. The Petitioner is running such Tiffin Stall at Railway Station Square, Unit-III, Kharavela Nagar, Bhubaneswar. Ms. Prajna Priyambada, learned counsel for Bhubaneswar Municipal Corporation submits that no such application has yet been received by the Town Vending Committee of Bhubaneswar Municipal Corporation (BMC). 5. Considering the submissions made by learned counsel for the parties, this Court feels that if the Petitioner intends to get vending certificate under the provisions of the Street Vendors (Protection of Livelihood and Regulation of Street Vending) Act, 2014 and the Rules framed thereunder, he should make a fresh application in that regard enclosing relevant documents and information.
